U-turn.description: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

Upper Hand.name: Upper Hand
Upper Hand.description: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn't about to use a priority move.

Uproar.name: Uproar
Uproar.description: The user gains the Uproar status.

Venoshock.name: Venoshock
Venoshock.description: This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

Volt Switch.name: Volt Switch
Volt Switch.description: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.

Volt Tackle.name: Volt Tackle
Volt Tackle.description: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target. The user also takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

Water Pulse.name: Water Pulse
Water Pulse.description: Has a 20% chance of confusing the target.

Water Shuriken.name: Water Shuriken
Water Shuriken.description: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.

Water Spout.name: Water Spout
Water Spout.description: The less HP the user has left the lower this move's power (ranging between 1 and 150).

Waterfall.name: Waterfall
Waterfall.description: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

Wave Crash.name: Wave Crash
Wave Crash.description: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

Weather Ball.name: Weather Ball
Weather Ball.description: When a weather condition is present this move's power is doubled and its type changes. Harsh sunlight Fire type. Rain Water type. Snow Ice type. Sandstorm Rock type.

Whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
Whirlpool.description: Gives the target the Bound status. This move's power is doubled if the target has the Submerged status.

Whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
Whirlwind.description: If there are other Pokémon in the target's party that can switch into battle the target is forced to switch out of battle and is replaced by one of those Pokémon at random.

Wide Guard.name: Wide Guard
Wide Guard.description: During the turn this move is used the user protects its side from moves that target all allies.

Wild Charge.name: Wild Charge
Wild Charge.description: The user takes 1/4 of the damage dealt by this move.

Wish.name: Wish
Wish.description: Gives the user's spot the Wish status.

Wonder Room.name: Wonder Room
Wonder Room.description: Gives the entire field the Wonder Room status for 5 turns.

Wood Hammer.name: Wood Hammer
Wood Hammer.description: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.

Worry Seed.name: Worry Seed
Worry Seed.description: Changes the target's Ability to Insomnia.

Wrap.name: Wrap
Wrap.description: Gives the target the Bound status.

Yawn.name: Yawn
Yawn.description: Makes the target drowsy. This move never misses.

Zen Headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
Zen Headbutt.description: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

Zing Zap.name: Zing Zap
Zing Zap.description: Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.
